description_en: Queries the logs of an SSL server
description_zh: 调用DescribeVpnSslServerLogs接口查看SSL服务端的日志
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-vpn-ssl-server-logs --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpn-ssl-server-id vss-bp155e9yclsg1xgq40000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVpnSslServerLogs

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the SSL server. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: SSL服务端所在的地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SSL server
parameters.name: vpn_ssl_server_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SSL client certificate
parameters.name: ssl_vpn_client_cert_id

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the log. Only UNIX timestamps in seconds are supported. For example, 1600738962 represents 2020-09-22 09:42:42.

If you specify From, you must also specify To or MinutePeriod
parameters.help_zh:
日志起始时间，仅支持传入UNIX秒级时间戳，例如1600738962，1600738962表示的时间为2020年09月22日09:42:42。

如果指定From，则必须指定To或MinutePeriod
parameters.name: from

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the log. Only UNIX timestamps in seconds are supported. For example, 1600738962 represents 2020-09-22 09:42:42.

If you specify To, you must also specify From or MinutePeriod
parameters.help_zh:
日志结束时间，仅支持传入UNIX秒级时间戳，例如1600738962，1600738962表示的时间为2020年09月22日09:42:42。

如果指定To，则必须指定From或MinutePeriod
parameters.name: to

parameters.help_en:
The log period. Unit: minutes.

If you do not specify From or To, you must specify MinutePeriod
parameters.help_zh:
日志周期。单位：分钟。

如果不指定From和To，则必须指定MinutePeriod
parameters.name: minute_period

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page when using paging. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数，最大值：50，默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

IsCompleted.description_en:
Indicates whether the queried logs are accurate. Valid values:

true: Accurate.

false: Not accurate
IsCompleted.description_zh:
查询的日志是否精确。取值：

true：精确。

false：不精确

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
